description: Perform a monthly bookkeeping close from bank reconciliation through financial statement preparation.

steps.description: Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts against the general ledger.

inputs.name: bank-statements
inputs.desc: Bank and credit card statements for the period

outputs.name: reconciliation-report
outputs.desc: Account-by-account reconciliation with variances

outputs.name: unmatched-items
outputs.desc: List of unmatched transactions requiring investigation

process: Import bank statement transactions and ledger entries for each account.
Match transactions by amount, date, and reference number.
Flag unmatched items and investigate discrepancies.
Document reconciling items (outstanding checks, deposits in transit).

steps.description: Record accruals, deferrals, and prepaid adjustments for the period.

inputs.name: accrual-schedule
inputs.desc: Schedule of recurring accruals and prepaids

outputs.name: adjustment-entries
outputs.desc: Journal entries for accruals and prepaids

outputs.name: updated-ledger
outputs.desc: General ledger with adjustments posted

process: Review the accrual schedule for recurring items (rent, insurance, payroll).
Calculate the adjustment amount for each item based on the period.
Prepare and post the adjusting journal entries.
Reverse prior-period accruals that have now been invoiced.

steps.description: Reconcile accounts receivable and accounts payable subledgers to the general ledger.

inputs.name: subledger-reports
inputs.desc: AR and AP subledger detail reports

outputs.name: subledger-reconciliation
outputs.desc: AR and AP reconciliation with variances

outputs.name: aging-summary
outputs.desc: Aging summary for receivables and payables

process: Pull the AR subledger total and compare to the GL control account.
Pull the AP subledger total and compare to the GL control account.
Investigate and resolve any differences.
Generate aging summaries for both receivables and payables.

steps.description: Review the trial balance for errors, unusual balances, and misclassifications.

inputs.name: updated-ledger
inputs.desc: General ledger with all adjustments posted

inputs.name: prior-period-trial-balance
inputs.desc: Previous period trial balance for comparison

outputs.name: reviewed-trial-balance
outputs.desc: Trial balance with review notes

outputs.name: correction-entries
outputs.desc: Any correcting journal entries identified

process: Generate the adjusted trial balance and verify debits equal credits.
Compare each account balance to the prior period and budget.
Investigate significant variances or unusual balances.
Post any correcting entries found during review.

steps.description: Prepare the monthly financial statements: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement.

inputs.name: prior-period-financials
inputs.desc: Previous period financial statements for comparison

outputs.name: income-statement
outputs.desc: Profit and loss statement for the period

outputs.name: balance-sheet
outputs.desc: Balance sheet as of period end

outputs.name: cash-flow-statement
outputs.desc: Statement of cash flows for the period

process: Map trial balance accounts to income statement line items and compute net income.
Map trial balance accounts to balance sheet line items and verify assets equal liabilities plus equity.
Prepare the cash flow statement using the indirect method.
Add comparative period columns and variance analysis.

steps.description: Compile the month-end close package with all supporting schedules and sign-offs.

outputs.name: close-package
outputs.desc: Complete month-end close package

outputs.name: close-checklist
outputs.desc: Completed close checklist with sign-offs

process: Assemble the financial statements, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
Complete the close checklist confirming all steps were performed.
Obtain review sign-off from the controller or accounting manager.
Archive the close package and lock the period in the accounting system.

description: Prepare and file a tax return from document gathering through electronic filing.

steps.description: Gather all income documents, deduction records, and prior-year returns.

outputs.name: document-inventory
outputs.desc: Complete list of collected tax documents

outputs.name: missing-items
outputs.desc: List of documents still needed

process: Request all W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, and other income documents.
Collect deduction records (mortgage interest, charitable donations, medical expenses).
Obtain the prior-year return for reference and carryforward items.
Verify all documents are received and flag missing items.

steps.description: Organize tax documents by category: income, deductions, credits, and carryforwards.

outputs.name: categorized-items
outputs.desc: Tax items organized by schedule and form

outputs.name: deduction-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of itemized vs standard deduction comparison

process: Classify each document by income type (wages, interest, dividends, business, capital gains).
Organize deductions by category and compare itemized total to standard deduction.
Identify applicable credits (child tax credit, education, energy).
Note any carryforward items from prior years (capital losses, NOLs).

steps.description: Prepare the tax return using the appropriate forms and schedules.

outputs.name: draft-return
outputs.desc: Completed draft tax return with all schedules

outputs.name: tax-liability-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of tax owed or refund due

process: Enter income items on the appropriate forms and schedules.
Apply the selected deduction method and enter deductions.
Calculate credits and apply against tax liability.
Compute the final tax liability, payments made, and refund or balance due.

steps.description: Review the draft return for accuracy, optimization opportunities, and common errors.

outputs.name: reviewed-return
outputs.desc: Reviewed tax return with corrections

outputs.name: review-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on optimization opportunities and risk areas

process: Cross-check all amounts against source documents.
Verify calculations and form carryovers between schedules.
Check for missed deductions or credits.
Flag any positions that could trigger audit scrutiny.

steps.description: File the tax return electronically and confirm acceptance.

outputs.name: filing-confirmation
outputs.desc: Electronic filing confirmation with tracking number

outputs.name: workpaper-package
outputs.desc: Complete set of supporting workpapers

process: Obtain taxpayer signature or authorization for e-file.
Transmit the return electronically to the taxing authority.
Verify acceptance and save the confirmation.
Assemble and archive the workpaper package with all source documents.

description: Conduct a financial statement audit from planning through opinion issuance.

steps.description: Plan the audit: assess risks, set materiality, and define scope.

outputs.name: audit-plan
outputs.desc: Detailed audit plan with risk assessment and materiality

outputs.name: engagement-letter
outputs.desc: Signed engagement letter defining scope and terms

process: Assess inherent and control risks for each financial statement assertion.
Calculate planning materiality and performance materiality.
Design the audit approach (substantive vs controls reliance) for each area.
Prepare the engagement letter and obtain client acceptance.

steps.description: Test the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls.

inputs.name: audit-plan
inputs.desc: Audit plan identifying key controls to test

outputs.name: controls-test-results
outputs.desc: Results of controls testing with exceptions noted

outputs.name: controls-reliance-decision
outputs.desc: Decision on whether to rely on controls

process: Identify the key controls relevant to financial reporting assertions.
Perform walkthroughs to confirm control design is appropriate.
Select samples and test operating effectiveness.
Document exceptions and assess their impact on the audit approach.

steps.description: Perform substantive audit procedures: confirmations, analytical procedures, and detail testing.

inputs.name: audit-plan
inputs.desc: Audit plan with substantive procedures defined

outputs.name: substantive-results
outputs.desc: Results of all substantive procedures performed

outputs.name: misstatements-log
outputs.desc: Log of identified misstatements

process: Send confirmations (bank, receivable, payable, legal) and evaluate responses.
Perform analytical procedures comparing actuals to expectations.
Test details of account balances (vouching, tracing, recalculation).
Document all findings and accumulate identified misstatements.

steps.description: Evaluate audit findings, assess misstatements, and determine their effect on the opinion.

outputs.name: misstatement-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of misstatements against materiality

outputs.name: management-letter-items
outputs.desc: Control deficiencies and recommendations

process: Aggregate all identified misstatements (factual, judgmental, projected).
Compare total misstatement to materiality thresholds.
Classify control deficiencies as significant deficiencies or material weaknesses.
Discuss findings with management and obtain representations.

steps.description: Form the audit opinion and issue the audit report.

outputs.name: audit-report
outputs.desc: Issued audit report with opinion

outputs.name: management-letter
outputs.desc: Letter to management with deficiency recommendations

process: Determine the appropriate opinion type (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer).
Draft the audit report with the required elements.
Issue the management letter with control deficiency recommendations.
Complete the audit file documentation and archive.

description: Build a budget forecast from historical analysis through scenario modeling and leadership review.

steps.description: Collect and analyze historical financial actuals and trends.

outputs.name: trend-analysis
outputs.desc: Revenue and expense trend analysis with growth rates

outputs.name: seasonality-patterns
outputs.desc: Identified seasonal patterns in the data

process: Import historical revenue and expense data by category and period.
Calculate growth rates, averages, and trend lines for each category.
Identify seasonal patterns and cyclical trends.
Flag anomalies and one-time items that should not be extrapolated.

steps.description: Gather budget requests from each department with justifications.

inputs.name: trend-analysis
inputs.desc: Historical trends to inform department budgets

outputs.name: department-requests
outputs.desc: Compiled budget requests from all departments

outputs.name: headcount-plan
outputs.desc: Planned headcount changes and associated costs

process: Distribute budget templates with historical baselines to department heads.
Collect completed budget requests with line-item justifications.
Review headcount plans (new hires, attrition, reorganizations).
Consolidate all department submissions into a single workbook.

steps.description: Build the revenue forecast using bottom-up or top-down methods.

inputs.name: sales-pipeline
inputs.desc: Current sales pipeline and booking projections

outputs.name: revenue-forecast
outputs.desc: Projected revenue by product line and period

outputs.name: revenue-assumptions
outputs.desc: Key assumptions underlying the revenue forecast

process: Build a bottom-up forecast from the sales pipeline and customer contracts.
Build a top-down forecast from market size and growth rate assumptions.
Reconcile the two approaches and select the final forecast basis.
Document all key assumptions (pricing, volume, churn, new business).

steps.description: Build the expense forecast by category: personnel, operating, and capital.

outputs.name: expense-forecast
outputs.desc: Projected expenses by category and period

outputs.name: capex-plan
outputs.desc: Capital expenditure plan

process: Calculate personnel costs from the headcount plan (salary, benefits, taxes).
Consolidate operating expense requests by category.
Separate capital expenditures and plan depreciation/amortization.
Apply inflation assumptions to applicable expense categories.

steps.description: Model base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios for the budget.

outputs.name: scenario-models
outputs.desc: Three-scenario model (base, optimistic, pessimistic)

outputs.name: sensitivity-results
outputs.desc: Sensitivity analysis on key variables

process: Define the key variables that drive the optimistic and pessimistic cases.
Build the optimistic scenario (higher revenue, lower costs, faster growth).
Build the pessimistic scenario (lower revenue, higher costs, slower growth).
Run sensitivity analysis on the top 5 variables to quantify impact.

steps.description: Consolidate the budget, review with leadership, and finalize.

outputs.name: approved-budget
outputs.desc: Final approved budget document

outputs.name: budget-presentation
outputs.desc: Budget presentation for board or leadership

process: Consolidate all inputs into the master budget (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).
Prepare the budget presentation with key metrics and scenario comparison.
Present to leadership and incorporate feedback.
Finalize and distribute the approved budget to departments.

description: Conduct a cost-benefit analysis for a business decision including NPV, ROI, and sensitivity testing.

steps.description: Define the decision, the alternatives being compared, and the evaluation criteria.

inputs.name: decision-description
inputs.desc: Description of the business decision to be made

outputs.name: decision-framework
outputs.desc: Structured framework with alternatives and criteria

outputs.name: evaluation-scope
outputs.desc: Time horizon, discount rate, and boundary conditions

process: State the decision clearly and identify all viable alternatives including status quo.
Define the evaluation criteria (financial and non-financial).
Set the time horizon for the analysis.
Determine the appropriate discount rate for NPV calculations.

steps.description: Identify and estimate all costs: direct, indirect, and opportunity costs.

outputs.name: cost-estimates
outputs.desc: Itemized cost estimates for each alternative by period

outputs.name: cost-assumptions
outputs.desc: Assumptions behind each cost estimate

process: Identify direct costs (purchase price, implementation, labor, materials).
Identify indirect costs (training, downtime, maintenance, overhead).
Estimate opportunity costs for each alternative.
Assign costs to time periods across the evaluation horizon.

steps.description: Identify and estimate all benefits: revenue, savings, and intangible value.

outputs.name: benefit-estimates
outputs.desc: Itemized benefit estimates for each alternative by period

outputs.name: benefit-assumptions
outputs.desc: Assumptions behind each benefit estimate

process: Identify revenue benefits (new sales, price increases, market expansion).
Identify cost-saving benefits (efficiency gains, headcount reduction, waste reduction).
Estimate intangible benefits and assign proxy values where possible.
Assign benefits to time periods across the evaluation horizon.

steps.description: Compute NPV, ROI, payback period, and IRR for each alternative.

outputs.name: financial-metrics
outputs.desc: NPV, ROI, payback period, and IRR for each alternative

outputs.name: comparison-table
outputs.desc: Side-by-side comparison of all alternatives

process: Calculate net cash flows per period (benefits minus costs) for each alternative.
Compute NPV using the established discount rate.
Calculate ROI, payback period, and IRR.
Build a comparison table ranking alternatives by each metric.

steps.description: Perform sensitivity analysis on key assumptions to test the stability of the recommendation.

outputs.name: sensitivity-results
outputs.desc: Impact of varying key assumptions on the outcome

outputs.name: break-even-points
outputs.desc: Values at which the recommendation changes

process: Identify the top 5 assumptions with the most impact on the result.
Vary each assumption independently and recalculate NPV/ROI.
Determine break-even values where the recommendation would change.
Summarize which assumptions the decision is most sensitive to.

steps.description: Produce the cost-benefit analysis report with recommendation.

outputs.name: cba-report
outputs.desc: Complete cost-benefit analysis report with recommendation

outputs.name: executive-summary
outputs.desc: One-page executive summary of the analysis

process: Write the executive summary with the recommended alternative and key rationale.
Present the detailed analysis with methodology, assumptions, and calculations.
Include sensitivity analysis results and risk factors.
State the recommendation with conditions and next steps.

description: Manage accounts receivable from invoice generation through collection and aging reporting.

steps.description: Generate and send invoices based on completed work or delivered goods.

inputs.name: billing-data
inputs.desc: Data for invoices (customer, amounts, terms, descriptions)

inputs.name: invoice-template
inputs.desc: Standard invoice template with company details

outputs.name: issued-invoices
outputs.desc: List of invoices generated with amounts and due dates

outputs.name: invoice-ledger-entries
outputs.desc: Journal entries to record the receivables

process: Validate billing data against contracts or purchase orders.
Generate invoices with correct terms, amounts, and payment instructions.
Send invoices to customers via the designated channel.
Post the receivable entries to the general ledger.

steps.description: Track payment status and aging for all outstanding invoices.

outputs.name: aging-report
outputs.desc: Invoice aging report (current, 30, 60, 90+ days)

outputs.name: overdue-list
outputs.desc: List of overdue invoices with customer contact info

process: Match incoming payments to open invoices.
Calculate days outstanding for each unpaid invoice.
Categorize into aging buckets (current, 30, 60, 90+ days).
Generate the overdue list sorted by amount and days outstanding.

steps.description: Follow up on overdue accounts with escalating collection actions.

inputs.name: collection-policy
inputs.desc: Company collection policy and escalation rules

outputs.name: collection-actions
outputs.desc: Log of collection actions taken

outputs.name: payment-commitments
outputs.desc: Customer payment commitments obtained

process: Send reminder notices for invoices 30 days overdue.
Make phone contact for invoices 60 days overdue.
Escalate to management or collections for invoices 90+ days overdue.
Document all communications and payment commitments received.

steps.description: Apply payments received and reconcile the receivables ledger.

outputs.name: applied-payments
outputs.desc: Payments matched to invoices

outputs.name: unapplied-cash
outputs.desc: Unidentified payments requiring investigation

process: Match payments to open invoices by customer, amount, and reference.
Apply partial payments and track remaining balances.
Investigate and resolve unapplied or unidentified payments.
Post payment entries and update the AR subledger.

steps.description: Assess bad debt exposure and record allowance or write-offs.

outputs.name: bad-debt-estimate
outputs.desc: Estimated allowance for doubtful accounts

outputs.name: write-off-recommendations
outputs.desc: Invoices recommended for write-off

process: Review the aging report and identify accounts with high risk of non-payment.
Calculate the allowance for doubtful accounts using historical loss rates.
Identify specific invoices that meet write-off criteria.
Prepare the journal entries for allowance adjustment and write-offs.

steps.description: Report on accounts receivable metrics: DSO, aging distribution, and collection rates.

inputs.name: applied-payments
inputs.desc: Payment application data for the period

outputs.name: ar-metrics-report
outputs.desc: AR metrics report with DSO, aging, and collection rates

outputs.name: trend-comparison
outputs.desc: Trend comparison against prior periods

process: Calculate days sales outstanding (DSO) for the period.
Compute the aging distribution as a percentage of total receivables.
Calculate collection rates and effectiveness metrics.
Compare to prior periods and identify trends.

description: Process payroll from time collection through tax filing and register reconciliation.

steps.description: Collect and validate time and attendance data for all employees.

inputs.name: employee-roster
inputs.desc: Active employee list with pay rates and schedules

outputs.name: validated-timesheets
outputs.desc: Approved timesheets for all employees

outputs.name: exceptions-list
outputs.desc: Time entry exceptions requiring resolution

process: Import time records from the time tracking system.
Validate against employee schedules and identify discrepancies.
Route exceptions to supervisors for approval.
Lock the pay period once all timesheets are approved.

steps.description: Calculate gross pay including regular hours, overtime, bonuses, and commissions.

outputs.name: gross-pay-register
outputs.desc: Gross pay calculations for each employee

outputs.name: overtime-report
outputs.desc: Overtime hours and costs by department

process: Calculate regular pay (hourly rate times regular hours or salary proration).
Calculate overtime pay at the applicable rate (1.5x or 2x).
Add bonuses, commissions, and other supplemental pay.
Generate the gross pay register and overtime report.

steps.description: Compute all withholdings: federal, state, and local taxes plus benefit deductions.

inputs.name: employee-tax-elections
inputs.desc: W-4 elections and benefit enrollment data

outputs.name: net-pay-register
outputs.desc: Net pay after all withholdings

outputs.name: tax-liability-summary
outputs.desc: Total tax liabilities by jurisdiction

process: Calculate federal income tax withholding based on W-4 elections.
Calculate state and local income tax withholdings.
Calculate FICA (Social Security and Medicare) for employee and employer.
Deduct benefit premiums (health, dental, vision, retirement contributions).

steps.description: Generate pay stubs and distribute payments via direct deposit or check.

inputs.name: net-pay-register
inputs.desc: Net pay amounts and bank details

outputs.name: payment-file
outputs.desc: ACH file or check run for distribution

outputs.name: pay-stubs
outputs.desc: Individual pay stubs for each employee

process: Generate the ACH direct deposit file with bank routing and account numbers.
Print checks for employees not on direct deposit.
Generate individual pay stubs with gross, deductions, and net details.
Distribute pay stubs electronically or in print.

steps.description: File payroll tax returns and remit tax deposits to federal, state, and local authorities.

outputs.name: tax-deposit-confirmations
outputs.desc: Confirmation of tax deposits made

outputs.name: quarterly-return-data
outputs.desc: Data accumulated for quarterly return filing

process: Calculate the deposit due date based on the deposit schedule (semi-weekly or monthly).
Remit federal tax deposits via EFTPS.
Remit state and local tax deposits per jurisdiction requirements.
Accumulate data for quarterly Form 941 and state returns.

steps.description: Reconcile the payroll register to the general ledger and bank account.

outputs.name: payroll-reconciliation
outputs.desc: Reconciliation of payroll to GL and bank

outputs.name: payroll-journal-entries
outputs.desc: Journal entries for payroll expense and liabilities

process: Compare the payroll register totals to the GL payroll accounts.
Verify the bank account reflects the correct total disbursement.
Investigate and resolve any differences.
Post the payroll journal entries to the general ledger.

description: Audit employee expense reports for policy compliance and accurate reimbursement.

steps.description: Review submitted expense reports against company policy and documentation requirements.

outputs.name: review-results
outputs.desc: Each expense item marked as approved, questioned, or denied

outputs.name: policy-exceptions
outputs.desc: Items that fall outside policy limits or categories

process: Verify each expense item has a valid receipt or documentation.
Check amounts against policy limits (per diem, mileage rate, category caps).
Verify the business purpose is documented for each expense.
Flag items that exceed limits or lack documentation.

steps.description: Check for duplicate submissions across expense reports and corporate card statements.

outputs.name: duplicate-flags
outputs.desc: Potential duplicate expenses identified

outputs.name: card-reconciliation
outputs.desc: Reconciliation of card charges to expense reports

process: Compare expense items across reports for matching amounts, dates, and vendors.
Cross-reference personal reimbursement claims against corporate card charges.
Flag potential duplicates for investigation.
Resolve confirmed duplicates and adjust reimbursement amounts.

steps.description: Validate that the proper approval chain was followed for each expense report.

inputs.name: approval-matrix
inputs.desc: Required approvers by amount and department

outputs.name: approval-validation
outputs.desc: Approval chain validation results

outputs.name: escalation-items
outputs.desc: Reports missing required approvals

process: Check that each report has the required approver based on amount thresholds.
Verify the approver has authority for the submitter's department.
Identify reports that bypassed the required approval chain.
Route reports missing approvals back for proper authorization.

steps.description: Process approved reimbursements and record the expense entries.

outputs.name: reimbursement-batch
outputs.desc: Payment batch for approved reimbursements

outputs.name: expense-journal-entries
outputs.desc: Journal entries for expense recording

process: Calculate the total approved reimbursement per employee.
Generate the payment batch (ACH or check).
Code expenses to the correct GL accounts and cost centers.
Post the expense journal entries.

steps.description: Produce the expense audit summary with findings and recommendations.

outputs.name: expense-audit-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of audit findings and statistics

outputs.name: policy-recommendations
outputs.desc: Recommendations for policy updates

process: Summarize the total expenses reviewed, approved, and denied.
List the top policy violations by category and frequency.
Calculate the savings from denied or reduced claims.
Recommend policy updates to address recurring issues.

description: Manage sales tax compliance from nexus determination through return filing and reconciliation.

steps.description: Determine sales tax nexus in each jurisdiction based on physical presence and economic activity.

inputs.name: business-activities
inputs.desc: Business operations, locations, and sales by state

outputs.name: nexus-assessment
outputs.desc: Jurisdictions where the business has nexus

outputs.name: registration-requirements
outputs.desc: Registration actions needed in new jurisdictions

process: Identify physical presence (offices, warehouses, employees) by jurisdiction.
Calculate economic activity (revenue, transaction count) against thresholds.
Determine nexus status for each jurisdiction.
Identify jurisdictions requiring new registrations.

steps.description: Calculate the correct sales tax on each transaction based on product type and jurisdiction.

inputs.name: transaction-data
inputs.desc: Sales transactions with product details and ship-to addresses

inputs.name: tax-rate-table
inputs.desc: Tax rates by jurisdiction, product category, and exemption

outputs.name: taxed-transactions
outputs.desc: Transactions with calculated tax amounts

outputs.name: exemption-log
outputs.desc: Transactions exempt from tax with reason codes

process: Determine the taxing jurisdiction based on the ship-to address.
Look up the applicable tax rate for the product category.
Apply exemptions (resale certificates, tax-exempt customers, exempt products).
Calculate the tax amount for each transaction.

steps.description: Prepare and file sales tax returns for each jurisdiction by the required deadline.

inputs.name: taxed-transactions
inputs.desc: Transactions with calculated tax for the period

outputs.name: filed-returns
outputs.desc: Filed returns with confirmation numbers

outputs.name: tax-payments
outputs.desc: Tax payment amounts remitted to each jurisdiction

process: Aggregate taxable sales and tax collected by jurisdiction.
Complete the return form for each jurisdiction.
Submit the return and remit the tax payment by the filing deadline.
Save filing confirmations and payment receipts.

steps.description: Reconcile tax collected against tax remitted and resolve variances.

outputs.name: reconciliation-report
outputs.desc: Reconciliation of tax collected vs remitted

outputs.name: variance-explanations
outputs.desc: Explanations for any differences

process: Compare total tax collected to total tax remitted by jurisdiction.
Identify variances from timing differences, adjustments, or errors.
Document explanations for each variance.
Record any liability or receivable adjustments in the general ledger.

steps.description: Produce the sales tax compliance report with filing status and rate change tracking.

outputs.name: compliance-report
outputs.desc: Sales tax compliance status report

outputs.name: rate-change-alerts
outputs.desc: Upcoming rate changes and exemption updates

process: Summarize filing status (on time, late, pending) by jurisdiction.
Report on reconciliation results and outstanding variances.
Monitor for upcoming rate changes and new legislation.
Update the tax rate table for the next period.

description: Analyze a company's financial health through ratio analysis and peer benchmarking.

steps.description: Calculate liquidity ratios: current ratio, quick ratio, and cash ratio.

outputs.name: liquidity-ratios
outputs.desc: Current, quick, and cash ratios with interpretation

outputs.name: working-capital-analysis
outputs.desc: Working capital calculation and trend

process: Calculate the current ratio (current assets divided by current liabilities).
Calculate the quick ratio (excluding inventory and prepaids).
Calculate the cash ratio (cash and equivalents only).
Analyze working capital adequacy and trend over time.

steps.description: Calculate profitability ratios: gross margin, net margin, ROE, and ROA.

inputs.name: balance-sheet
inputs.desc: Balance sheet data for asset and equity bases

outputs.name: profitability-ratios
outputs.desc: Margin and return ratios with interpretation

outputs.name: dupont-decomposition
outputs.desc: DuPont analysis breaking ROE into components

process: Calculate gross margin, operating margin, and net profit margin.
Calculate return on assets (ROA) and return on equity (ROE).
Perform DuPont decomposition (margin times turnover times leverage).
Compare to prior periods to identify trends.

steps.description: Calculate leverage ratios: debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets, and interest coverage.

inputs.name: balance-sheet
inputs.desc: Balance sheet with debt and equity details

outputs.name: leverage-ratios
outputs.desc: Debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets, and interest coverage

outputs.name: debt-capacity-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of remaining borrowing capacity

process: Calculate debt-to-equity ratio (total debt divided by total equity).
Calculate debt-to-assets ratio.
Calculate interest coverage ratio (EBIT divided by interest expense).
Assess debt capacity relative to covenants and industry norms.

steps.description: Calculate efficiency ratios: inventory turnover, receivables turnover, and asset turnover.

inputs.name: income-statement
inputs.desc: Revenue and cost of goods sold

outputs.name: efficiency-ratios
outputs.desc: Turnover ratios with days outstanding calculations

outputs.name: cash-conversion-cycle
outputs.desc: Cash conversion cycle in days

process: Calculate inventory turnover and days inventory outstanding.
Calculate receivables turnover and days sales outstanding.
Calculate payables turnover and days payable outstanding.
Compute the cash conversion cycle (DIO + DSO minus DPO).

steps.description: Benchmark the company's ratios against industry peers.

outputs.name: benchmark-comparison
outputs.desc: Company vs peer comparison by ratio category

outputs.name: strengths-weaknesses
outputs.desc: Identified financial strengths and weaknesses

process: Select appropriate peer companies or industry averages for comparison.
Compare each ratio category against the peer set.
Identify ratios where the company outperforms or underperforms peers.
Summarize financial strengths and areas needing improvement.

steps.description: Produce the financial analysis report with findings and recommendations.

outputs.name: financial-analysis-report
outputs.desc: Complete financial ratio analysis report

outputs.name: action-items
outputs.desc: Recommended actions to improve financial health

process: Summarize the overall financial health assessment.
Present key findings by ratio category with visualizations.
Highlight areas requiring management attention.
Recommend specific actions to improve weak ratios.

description: Manage grant finances from account setup through expenditure tracking and audit preparation.

steps.description: Set up the grant accounting structure with fund codes and cost categories.

inputs.name: grant-agreement
inputs.desc: Signed grant agreement with budget and terms

outputs.name: grant-fund-structure
outputs.desc: Fund codes and cost categories mapped to the grant budget

outputs.name: compliance-requirements
outputs.desc: Financial reporting and compliance requirements

process: Create the fund code and cost center for the grant in the accounting system.
Map the grant budget categories to GL accounts.
Set up spending limits and authorization rules per the grant terms.
Document the reporting schedule and compliance requirements.

steps.description: Track expenditures against the grant budget by cost category.

inputs.desc: Expense transactions charged to the grant

outputs.name: budget-vs-actual
outputs.desc: Budget to actual comparison by cost category

process: Code each expense to the correct grant cost category.
Compare cumulative spending to the budget by category.
Flag categories approaching the budget limit (80%+ spent).
Calculate the burn rate and project whether funds will last the grant period.

steps.description: Prepare interim and final financial reports per the grant schedule.

outputs.name: financial-report
outputs.desc: Grant financial report in the required format

outputs.name: narrative-supplement
outputs.desc: Narrative explaining variances and progress

process: Compile expenditures by category in the grantor's required format.
Calculate the percentage of budget expended.
Write the narrative explaining material variances from the budget.
Submit the report by the required deadline.

steps.description: Track cost sharing and matching contributions against grant requirements.

inputs.name: transaction-data
inputs.desc: Cost sharing transactions and in-kind contributions

outputs.name: cost-share-report
outputs.desc: Cost sharing contributions tracked against the requirement

outputs.name: shortfall-alert
outputs.desc: Alert if cost sharing is behind schedule

process: Identify and document cash and in-kind matching contributions.
Value in-kind contributions per the applicable cost principles.
Compare cumulative cost sharing to the required amount by period.
Alert if the cost share is not on pace to meet the requirement.

steps.description: Prepare for the grant audit by organizing documentation and testing compliance.

outputs.name: audit-ready-package
outputs.desc: Organized documentation for the grant audit

outputs.name: self-assessment-results
outputs.desc: Results of internal compliance self-assessment

process: Organize all financial records by cost category with supporting documentation.
Perform a self-assessment of compliance with grant terms and cost principles.
Prepare the schedule of expenditures of federal awards (if applicable).
Assemble the audit-ready package for the external auditor.

description: Assess internal financial controls for design and operating effectiveness.

steps.description: Identify key financial processes and the risks of material misstatement.

inputs.name: process-inventory
inputs.desc: List of financial processes to assess

outputs.name: risk-assessment
outputs.desc: Risk assessment for each financial process

outputs.name: high-risk-processes
outputs.desc: Processes requiring priority control assessment

process: List the key financial processes (revenue, purchasing, payroll, treasury, reporting).
Identify what could go wrong in each process (errors, fraud, omissions).
Assess the likelihood and financial impact of each risk.
Prioritize processes for control assessment based on risk score.

steps.description: Document the control activities: authorization, reconciliation, segregation of duties, and physical controls.

inputs.name: existing-documentation
inputs.desc: Any existing process documentation or flowcharts

outputs.name: control-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix of controls mapped to risks and assertions

outputs.name: process-narratives
outputs.desc: Written narratives or flowcharts for each process

process: Walk through each process with the process owner to understand the steps.
Identify the control activities at each step (approvals, reviews, reconciliations).
Document who performs each control and how frequently.
Map each control to the specific risk it mitigates.

steps.description: Test whether each control is properly designed to prevent or detect the target risk.

outputs.name: design-test-results
outputs.desc: Assessment of each control's design adequacy

outputs.name: design-gaps
outputs.desc: Risks without adequate control coverage

process: Evaluate whether each control addresses the identified risk.
Check for proper segregation of duties (authorization, custody, recording).
Identify risks that lack a control or have only a detective (not preventive) control.
Assess whether technology controls are properly configured.

steps.description: Test operating effectiveness by selecting samples and verifying the control was performed.

inputs.name: design-test-results
inputs.desc: Controls with adequate design to test

outputs.name: effectiveness-results
outputs.desc: Pass/fail results for each control tested

outputs.name: exceptions-found
outputs.desc: Instances where the control did not operate as designed

process: Select samples of transactions or events for each control.
Examine evidence that the control was performed (signatures, system logs, reconciliation marks).
Document exceptions where the control was not performed or was performed incorrectly.
Calculate the exception rate and assess whether the control is operating effectively.

steps.description: Classify identified deficiencies and recommend improvements.

outputs.name: deficiency-report
outputs.desc: Classified deficiencies (deficiency, significant deficiency, material weakness)

outputs.name: remediation-plan
outputs.desc: Recommended actions to address each deficiency

process: Classify each deficiency by severity (deficiency, significant deficiency, material weakness).
Assess the compensating controls that partially mitigate the risk.
Develop specific remediation recommendations for each deficiency.
Assign remediation owners and target completion dates.

steps.description: Produce the internal controls assessment report with findings and remediation plan.

outputs.name: controls-report
outputs.desc: Internal controls assessment report

outputs.name: management-action-plan
outputs.desc: Management response and action plan

process: Summarize the scope and methodology of the assessment.
Present findings organized by severity and process area.
Include the remediation plan with owners and timelines.
Obtain management response and action plan commitments.
